values.note: 138 sites, from tent sites to full RV hookups; most wooded, grassy areas in campground D. Primitive, electric/water, full-hookup and group sites. Two vehicles per site.

sites.source: https://www.breakspark.com/campground ('Our 138 camp sites range from a great place to pitch your tent to full RV hook-ups'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.breakspark.com/campground ('a well-stocked store and a laundry facility are available'; 'The Breaks Campground Store offers ... groceries, picnic supplies, firewood, and basic RV supplies'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Site-specific reservations online through the park's Firefly page ('Book Your Campsite Here'); check in at the campground store, late arrivals with a reservation find a packet on their site post, and those arriving after hours without one may call the ranger on call. $10 cancellation fee per site; cancel by calling (276) 865-4413 ext. 3201.

booking.source: https://www.breakspark.com/campground ('The Breaks Interstate Park reserves camping sites through a site-specific reservation system'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Rates unchanged on the park page ($27 primitive / $37 E-W / $41 full hookup, plus tax; fees left as human-checked 2026-10-12). Confirmed 138 sites, water+sewer hookups, Firefly site-specific booking; added season Apr 1-Oct 31 (Loop D open off-season this year), laundry and camp store. Not stated: electric amperage, max rig length, showers (not mentioned on the page).
flags: Fees base may be a tent site: the stored nightly_low is the $27 'Primitive Sites' rate, and the page describes the sites as ranging 'from a great place to pitch your tent to full RV hook-ups' without saying whether primitive sites take an RV. If they are tent-only, the RV base is the $37 electric/water rate. Fees are human-checked, so not changed.
Stale text on the operator page: 'The campground is open from April 1 through October 31, 2024' sits beside the current 'open seasonally from April 1 until October 31 of each year'.
